fact: ACP reported on 13 February 2025 that ANICNS had handed the Kasaï-Oriental provincial health division 516 computers, 206 tablets and 206 routers to equip 206 health care facilities, in order to put into service an ANICNS-approved hospital information system and ensure portability of the computerised patient record; the article reports equipment delivered, not systems in use.
title: Kasaï-Oriental : un lot d’équipements numériques offert à la division provinciale de la santé
